non_blocking_findings.finding: Export share/save delivery is wired through Android intents, but no device smoke has verified chooser launch, document creation, or saved JSON readability.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Cover share/save in NATIVE-P4-007 with screenshot/logcat evidence and import-back validation where feasible.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Settings exposes current-session and full-backup export actions. Graph-snapshot and preset export support is validated at protocol level but not exposed as separate Settings actions.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Decide before P6 whether graph/preset need separate user-facing export controls or are adequately covered through full backup and preset management flows.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Full-backup repository snapshot includes messages, but the full-backup protocol builder does not serialize messages in v1.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Resolve full-backup message serialization before replacement-readiness audit if full conversation restore is required by LEG-031/LEG-032.
